title: Tour Guide profile summary (payload of the `profile_summary` envelope)
description: The profile_summary envelope payload: { text }, the prefs kit's plain-text profile summary (no HTML, no Markdown, ≤ 1 200 characters, several lines). dimensions_count and updated are optional extras.

text.description: Plain text exactly as the prefs kit returns it (interview / apply → profile_summary).

updated.description: An ISO 8601 date-time with a zone (Z or ±HH:MM).
